prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1209; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision involving a side impact at an intersection. Initial evaluation documented right shoulder pain, restricted range of motion with limited abduction and external rotation, and tenderness over the anterior joint line. Imaging was reviewed and showed no fracture or dislocation; findings were consistent with a soft tissue injury, including a partial-thickness strain of the rotator cuff musculature.

Over the course of 15 supervised visits, the patient was treated with a combination of manual therapy, progressive therapeutic exercise targeting scapular stabilization and rotator cuff strengthening, and modalities for pain control. Range of motion improved steadily, and pain decreased from moderate at intake to mild at discharge. Strength testing at the final visit showed near-symmetrical function compared with the uninjured side, with residual mild weakness on resisted overhead movement.

The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to continue activity modification and to return if symptoms worsen. Prognosis for full functional recovery is good, with ongoing monitoring recommended if persistent discomfort develops.
